findings.issue: No formalized policy tier architecture - dev, RC, prod, and hotfix releases all use same workflow patterns with no graduated approval gates
findings.impact: Hotfix and release-candidate releases use same CI/CD path as dev; no staging environment to validate before prod
findings.fix: Define policy tiers (dev/RC/prod/hotfix) with graduated approval gates: dev=auto, RC=status checks, prod=environment approval, hotfix=emergency bypass with post-action review

findings.issue: Hotfix bypass is manual workflow_dispatch with no compensating controls - any user with write access can trigger prod deploy with inputs.rollback_sha
findings.impact: No mandatory PR review, status check, or post-deploy audit trail for emergency hotfixes
findings.fix: Add hotfix-specific job that requires PR approval from code owners, enforces status checks, and logs all hotfix activity to audit API

findings.issue: No policy configuration files - all governance is implicit in workflow files
findings.impact: Policy changes require editing workflow YAML; no centralized policy declaration or versioning separate from CI config
findings.fix: Create governance/policies/ directory with tier definitions (dev.yaml, rc.yaml, prod.yaml, hotfix.yaml) and a CI step that validates workflow triggers against declared policy

findings.issue: Policy changes are not independently tracked - changing workflow triggers, approval gates, or environment protections is not logged separately from code changes
findings.impact: Cannot audit when or why release policy was modified without manual git log inspection
findings.fix: Add policy change log in governance/CHANGELOG.md and require PR description to tag when policy-affecting files are modified

findings.issue: governance.yml is deprecated (v5, superseded by platform.yml v6) but still dispatchable - no cleanup or migration enforcement
findings.impact: Stale workflow may be triggered accidentally, producing misleading results
findings.fix: Add deprecation notice in workflow description or remove after confirming platform.yml covers all use cases
